verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.railway.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, Railway-specific content). Railway also publishes agent-oriented markdown docs, including agents.md, ai/mcp-server.md and cloud-agents.md, plus a use-railway skill that teaches coding agents how to operate the platform. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents consume these docs effectively, and visibility into how complete the llms.txt content is.
